annotations.text: Module doc: parallel-tree storage layout and the .ann.json schema
Tuning knobs: size/line caps, tab width, and directories hidden from the tree
Annotation palette — blend() derives all translucent shades from these six
Extension → tokenizer config; unknown extensions fall back to plain text
Core tokenizer: one pass per line; st carries block-comment/string state between lines
A single shared state dict threads multi-line comments and strings across the file
The transparency illusion: overlay colors are pre-blended against the editor background
Walks up to .git — decides the base that annotation paths are relative to
BUG (data loss): any parse error silently returns [] — the next save then OVERWRITES the corrupt file, erasing hand-edited annotations; surface load errors instead
PYTHON: annotations are plain dicts (string-keyed maps), not a class/struct — a typo'd key is only caught at runtime as a KeyError
Persistence: writes into the mirror tree; removing the last annotation prunes empty dirs
PYTHON gotcha handled right: nm=name freezes the loop value — closures capture variables, not values, so without it every swatch would pick the LAST color
PYTHON hack: builds a tuple to call _save() AND return 'break' in one expression — works, but a named two-line handler would be clearer
REVIEW: ~1250-line god class, 60+ methods, many interacting mode flags (_edit_mode, _paste_ann, _dragged...) — consider extracting find/editor/annotation-store before the next big feature
REVIEW portability: <MouseWheel>/event.delta is Windows+mac only — Linux/X11 sends Button-4/5 instead, so wheel scrolling silently does nothing there
REVIEW: edit mode is a second rendering pipeline (own gutter, wheel, highlight application) — the shared tokenizer is the key reuse, but UI tweaks must be made twice
BUG: rstrip strips a character SET, not a suffix — a filename ending in spaces or ● gets mangled; slice off the exact ' ●' suffix instead
PYTHON: `with open(...)` auto-closes the file even on error (RAII/using); errors='replace' swaps undecodable bytes for � — display-only lossiness, which is why edit mode re-reads strictly
PYTHON: list comprehension rebuilds every line; `or ['']` exploits truthiness (an empty list is false) to guarantee at least one line
REVIEW: 0x0004 is the Ctrl bit of Tk's event.state bitmask (0x0001 = Shift, used in _code_release) — correct but undocumented magic numbers
Z-order trick: bands go below the code text, notes above — keeps glyphs crisp

BUG (confirmed crash): if the file renders no code text (all blank lines) this raises TclError 'tagOrId "code" doesn’t match any items' — _draw_find/_set_selection guard with find_withtag first; this call doesn’t
REVIEW: each flash schedules a 4s clear but never cancels the previous timer, so an older timer wipes a newer message early — store the id and after_cancel it
PYTHON: slices are 0-based and end-EXCLUSIVE — [lo-1:hi] converts the app's 1-based inclusive range; first place to look if a line-range bug ever appears
REVIEW: mode 'wb' truncates the file BEFORE writing — a crash mid-save destroys the source; write a temp file then os.replace() for an atomic save
REVIEW: if the annotated region was deleted, the annotation keeps stale line numbers while other edits shift the file — consider flagging these as orphaned
Gutter click/drag selects a line range, then release opens the annotation editor
PYTHON: next((x for x in seq if cond), default) = 'find first match or default' — the loop is implicit in the generator expression
CLI entry: optional folder plus -a/--annotations to relocate the annotation tree
PYTHON: the file executes top-to-bottom on import; this guard runs main() only when launched as a program, keeping the pure functions importable and testable
